card.name: The word supportive before care
card.fires_on: The word "supportive" in adverse-reaction and overdose text, right before care, treatment or measures. Rarely it also fires on "hardware" before "-level".

modes.label: Supportive care
modes.description: "supportive" follows with, and or provide, and comes before care, treatment or measures when describing how a reaction is handled.
modes.example: Manage rash with<< supportive>> care or with dose modification if Grade

modes.label: Hardware encryption
modes.description: A stray case where "hardware" is followed by a hyphen and "level" in a tech passage.
modes.example: Android devices offer<< hardware>>-level encryption, but only on Honeycomb

card.plain: It marks the word "supportive" in phrases about managing side effects with supportive care.
